goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, navigate the calendar to the previous month, and successfully create a memo with specific content.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Previous month' button (left arrow) to navigate to May 2026.
In the text input area labeled 'Any thoughts...', type the message 'Team meeting at 3 PM to discuss Q3 goals.' and click the 'Save' button.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the signup page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view updates to display 'May 2026' after clicking the previous month navigation.
A new memo entry containing the text 'Team meeting at 3 PM to discuss Q3 goals.' appears at the top of the feed with a timestamp of 'now'.
The text input field is cleared after the memo is saved.
No error messages are displayed during account creation or memo saving.
